findings.suggested_fix: Translate the printed book names into standard French forms while leaving chapter and verse numbers and punctuation unchanged. For example: "Acts" → "Actes", "2 Corinthians" → "2 Corinthiens", "Jonah" → "Jonas", "Psalm" → "Psaume", "John" → "Jean", "Philippians" → "Philippiens", "Mark" → "Marc", "Luke" → "Luc", "Hebrews" → "Hébreux", "Matthew" → "Matthieu". Apply this consistently to every in-text Scripture citation (e.g. change "Acts 27:20" to "Actes 27:20", "2 Corinthians 11:25" to "2 Corinthiens 11:25", "Jonah 1:6" to "Jonas 1:6", "Psalm 107:25-30" to "Psaume 107:25-30", "Mark 8:35" to "Marc 8:35", etc.). Ensure the translated book names appear inside the same markup/emphasis tags as in the translation (italics, strong, etc.).
